title: Turnaround of the second reset sweep
statement: Let $S$ be a deterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $A$ be a nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $\ell$ be a Boolean, and let $x$ be a finite Boolean input word. For every $m\in\mathbb{N}$, choice bit $b$, valid input-head position $ip$, work-tape contents and head positions for both machines, one step of the host machine from phase $p1$, with the yard tape containing $m$ consecutive true symbols starting at cell $0$ and its head at cell $m$, leaves the phase-specific tapes of $S$ and the output unchanged, advances each work-tape head of $A$ by one, leaves the input-head position unchanged, keeps the yard tape unchanged, and enters phase $p2$ with the yard head at cell $m-1$.
